usedFor: TallyPrime holds accounting activity, and Sangam CRM follows up when “No Purchase Activity Detected” runs “Create or Update Lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “No Purchase Activity Detected” in TallyPrime, then “Create or Update Lead” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: A quiet buyer becomes a lead to chase, instead of going unnoticed.

watchOut: “New Receipt event occurs” fires on create, update and delete, so one receipt can run “Create or Update Lead” repeatedly.
